verdicts.reason: A reads left to right properly: brand and headline, then details and pills, then the RSVP button with its URL. Its flaws are a small headline, a cramped logo/eyebrow block, small tiny-text rows, an orphaned can and a placeholder box pinned to the bottom-right edge. B's reading order is jumbled: the time sits under the logo at far left, the 'Solstice presents' eyebrow is unreadably small, and the URL floats above the subtitle at the right. RSVP is shrunk to a pill the same size as the tags, so the CTA is buried. The pills touch with no gutters, and the placeholder box collides with 'Tastings'.
